name: Atom CP/M workshop
instruction: All files are on A:. Run ATOMDEMO.COM and press a key at the prompt. Edit ATOMDEMO.ASM with EDIT ATOMDEMO.ASM, then assemble a new copy with ATOM ATOMDEMO.ASM NEWDEMO.COM and run NEWDEMO.COM.

components.name: ATOM.COM
components.description: Atom 0.3.5, the native CP/M Z80 assembler.

components.name: EDIT.COM
components.description: Edit 0.2.0, the full-screen CP/M text editor.

components.name: ATOMDEMO.ASM and ATOMDEMO.COM
components.description: A CP/M console demo that prints a heading, counts to five, and waits for a key. Includes editable source and a ready-to-run program.
